caption:
Honored to be a speaker at the IEEE APS Chapter Jaipur's Professional Training Program on "Pedagogy and Modern Technology Tools" today! 
In this Session, I had the opportunity to share insights on the topic:
 "Empowering Education & Research with Open-Source Tools" 💻📚

Organized in association with the Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering, MNIT Jaipur, and the School of Engineering and Technology, Central University of Rajasthan, Ajmer. This initiative is part of a 15-day training series aimed at bridging pedagogy with technological advancements.

🔍 My session focused on:
The transformative role of open-source platforms in academic research.
How educators can leverage free tools to enhance classroom engagement.
Practical examples and success stories from real-world applications.

It was an enriching experience interacting with passionate educators and professionals eager to innovate in their teaching and research methodologies.

🙏 Heartfelt gratitude towards the Prof. MM Sharma and Dr. Manisha Gupta and Thank you to the IEEE Antennas and Propagation Society Chapter – Jaipur for giving me this opportunity, and kudos to the organizing team for curating such a forward-looking event!
